purpose: Display and compare immutable predictions with immutable experimental evidence without changing model semantics.

comparability_states.COMPARABLE_AFTER_DETERMINISTIC_CONVERSIO: Exact unit or log/fraction conversion recorded
comparability_states.CONDITIONALLY_COMPARABLE: Value representation matches but required context is incomplete
comparability_states.RELATED_NOT_SAME_ENDPOINT: Scientifically related but numerically different endpoint
comparability_states.NOT_COMPARABLE: Known incompatible endpoint, species, direction, or matrix

rules.activity: IC50, EC50, Ki, and Kd are distinct; only like-for-like concentration units may be converted.
rules.solubility: Molar values may convert to log10(mol/L); mass conversion requires exact compatible MW and remains condition-dependent.
rules.caco2: Only Caco-2 A→B Papp is eligible; linear cm/s may convert by log10.
rules.ppb: Human % bound and explicit fu/fraction may convert; other species are not comparable.
rules.clearance: HLM, RLM, and MLM remain isolated; no protein-to-kg scaling is introduced.
rules.classifiers: CYP, P-gp, and hERG probabilities never convert to IC50/Ki/Kd. Explicit categorical evidence can be compared separately.
rules.logd: Only compatible logD at pH 7.4 is direct; logP is related evidence.
rules.raw_evidence: raw_value, raw_unit, raw_relation, source and reference remain immutable.
